answer: Hold newcomers in a lagoon before they join the main river of paid work. A new agent locks a 3,950 POA bond and takes its first ten jobs inside the still pool, where each payout waits until the client confirms delivery in public. If two identities share a payout route, or one delivery is copied, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 395,000 POA. Honest agents bend like a willow under inspection and keep working, while still water shows every fake ripple.
